start_here: Say to your AI: "Run tool:gate-a-pieces-delivery-checklist with library, schema, command." Before I show or deliver a piece, tell me which checks of my delivery checklist are still open, failed or answered on old bytes, record each answer with its evidence, and hold back anything already linked for me to watch that has not passed

lists.label: Settings
lists.holds: One row per tool and scope (a person, a film, a piece or the whole account): the settings that tool reads when it runs, as JSON.

no_lists_because: The item names no list in its own words, input or steps, so it has no example rows to ship.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Run tool:gate-a-pieces-delivery-checklist", and give it library, schema, command.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:gate-a-pieces-delivery-checklist and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: The result the item's own job names: Before I show or deliver a piece, tell me which checks of my delivery checklist are still open, failed or answered on old bytes, record each answer with its evidence, and hold back anything already linked for me to watch that has not passed

worked_examples.title: Hold a piece back until every check of its delivery checklist has a pass with evidence (runs on your computer) on a sample input

input.library: <library: The folder the library's files are relative to, put where {library} is in the command>
input.schema: <schema: The schema file, or a file holding the person's list:settings row record:setting:keep-a-record-library-valid~<scope_kind>~<scope_id>, with its delivery_gate; put where {schema} is in the command>
input.command: <command: One of: gate <piece> --stage S5,S6 [--option IDS] [--at review|final]; answer <piece> --check ID --answer pass|fail|n/a --evidence TEXT --by NAME [--option ID]; answer-from-render-check <piece> --json REPORT; sweep <piece> --previews DIR; content-gates <piece> --lane-dir DIR [--option IDS] [--at STAGE]; audition-gates <piece> --file F [--at STAGE]; audit-watch <piece> [--hold] [--file F]; scope-options <piece> [--lane L]>

worked_examples.hands_back: The result the item's own job names: Before I show or deliver a piece, tell me which checks of my delivery checklist are still open, failed or answered on old bytes, record each answer with its evidence, and hold back anything already linked for me to watch that has not passed
worked_examples.given: The person gives: library, schema, command (shown as <name> in the input).

pour.how: Name the list you already keep for the same job and read it with records:read (its fields and row type). Run tool:pour-example-rows-into-my-list with that list as into and this kit list as kit_list: it matches each kit field to one of yours (your map, the same id, the same label, or a name in alike), pours nothing under 80% and names the fields with no home, and otherwise answers the one records:write that adds the example rows beside your own.
